why: Pi's bridge (helper/harnesses/pi/resources/bridge.js) does nothing outside the terminals Dispatch can show (its own, and tmux and herdr panes): no socket, no session record. The helper bundles it and writes it whole into every Pi installation reply and installation job, and its SHA-256 into the receipt, so every capture holding it holds the new copy and its hash instead. No answer depends on the script's text: the tests running Pi run it in Dispatch's terminals, where it behaves as before.
